title: People and Peer-Based Accommodations
description: Strategies that scaffold social interactions and use peers/adults as supports. Use when the student needs help building social skills, navigating unstructured time, self-advocating, or learning through peer modeling and role play.

source.name: ADayInOurShoes — Ultimate List of IEP Accommodations, Modifications & Strategies (SDIs)
source.section: People and Peer based accommodations and SDIs

accommodations.text: Special sign or signal between teacher and student to notify the student of something.
Encourage but do not force eye contact; forcing eye contact may break train of thought.
Set up opportunities for the child to self-advocate.
Peer modeling of appropriate play and interaction.
Pair the student with another student prior to learning a new task.
Facilitated socialization at recess, lunch, and breaks.
Education sessions for peers to help them understand the disability.
Watch videos of social stories or interactions and ask the student to explain them.
Role playing both successful and undesired outcomes (i.e., troubleshooting).
